items.title: Is Cigna Group (CI) Still Undervalued Or Are The Risks Keeping It Fairly Priced?
items.summary: Cigna Group (CI) continues to draw attention after its recent close at US$288.90, with investors weighing modest return figures across the past week, month, and past 3 months against the insurer's broader long term track record. Recent trading has been more mixed for Cigna Group, with the share price slipping 0.4% on the day but still posting a 4.7% 7 day gain and a 3.5% year to date share price return. The 1 year total shareholder return of 0.4% and 5 year total shareholder return of 56.7%...

items.title: CVS Stock Returned $24B In Cash: Why Did It Still Lag The Market?
items.summary: The health care giant showered its owners with cash, yet the stock spent years in the slow lane. Here’s the accounting of what that trade-off actually delivered.

items.title: Should You Buy UNH Stock Because Its Cash Runs Ahead Of Its Profit?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) has spent the past year repairing margins rather than chasing growth. The shares rebounded well ahead of any actual margin recovery: up about 38% over the past six months, though down about 6% over the past three, and still behind the S&P 500 over the past twelve months, 12.2% for the stock against 18.6% for the index. What argues for owning them now shows up in cash running ahead of reported profit.

items.title: Should You Buy Elevance Health Stock For The Margin It Lost?
items.summary: Elevance Health (ELV) has returned more than 40% over the past six months, though it is down 6.5% over the past three while the S&P 500 gained 3.4%. The next leg will not come from selling more insurance. It will come from keeping more of the premium it already collects.

items.title: Should You Buy, Hold or Sell CVS Stock Amid Consumer Wellness Growth?
items.summary: CVS is benefiting from pharmacy growth, AI investments and a discounted valuation, but reimbursement pressure and regulatory scrutiny remain key risks.

items.title: BTSG's Specialty Pharmacy Sales Up 30%: Will the Growth Continue?
items.summary: BrightSpring Health Services' Specialty and Infusion sales rose 30%, backed by LDD growth, new launches and expansion into rare therapies.

items.title: Why Is UNH Stock Trading At A Premium With The Slowest Growth?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) runs the best operating margin of the three managed care companies in its peer group, and the slowest revenue growth of the three. It also carries a significant valuation premium over its peer, Cigna, trading at more than double its earnings multiple.

items.title: Cigna Group Executive Neville Everett Sells 617 Shares for $175,000
items.summary: Everett disposed of 11% of his direct equity holdings under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, leaving a stake valued at $1.45 million.
